questions.question: A New Testament letter warns believers that what kind of people will secretly bring destructive teachings in among them?
When some of the angels sinned, what did God do with them?

answers.text: Cast them into hell in chains of darkness
Sent them out to wander the earth in exile
Set them to guard the way to Eden's tree

questions.question: Which preacher of righteousness did God preserve along with seven others when He sent the flood?
What is the final condition of people who escape the world's corruption by knowing Jesus, then get entangled in it again?

answers.text: Worse than it was at first
The same as it was before
